acceptanceCriteria: Each support-matrix row and each emitted degradation carries a condition with type, status, reason, message and last transition fields.
Every existing pinned FALLBACK string in cmd/corvint/host_adapter_test.go is unchanged.
A consumer test shows an old consumer ignoring the new fields.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-22 after reviewing google/ax (Apache-2.0) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. Prior art: the Kubernetes-style Condition message in pkg/apis/v1alpha1/ax.proto of https://github.com/google/ax (type, status, lastTransitionTime, reason, message) and the WorkspaceReady condition that ax watch renders as a transition. Current state: docs/specs/agent-harness-integration-v0.md reports support per (host, surface, host version, adapter version, OS) as FULL, FALLBACK or UNSUPPORTED, and cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go emits FALLBACK degradations as a coded reason inside a systemMessage or additionalContext string; neither surface carries a machine-readable reason, a human message and the revision or time at which the state last changed as separate fields. Add an additive condition record to the support-matrix rows and to the degradation wire so a consumer can read reason, message and last transition without parsing prose. Preserve every existing string the adapter tests pin; the change is additive and an old consumer must be able to ignore it.
title: adapter: condition records with reason, message and last transition time for support-matrix rows and degradations
